title: The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved
caption:
How does nature decide where hair grows? It turns out it's not a complex genetic blueprint after all. New research shows cells use simple chemical signals to organize into patterns.

Source: Sciencedaily - The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261109205413.htm
